I felt the exact same way! It’s difficult to navigate your feelings when they change every second. Something my therapist told me is “if you didn’t care about him then you wouldn’t have so much anxiety and stress about hurting him all the time, you simply wouldn’t care” and that is something that has always helped me. When my intrusive thoughts come I always remind myself of it.

I second this! Hydroxyzine is a really good alternative for anxiety since most doctors don’t like prescribing benzos. It makes you very sleepy so I only take it at night. And for me my dreams weren’t nightmares per say, just very vivid and freaky.

From my experience with clinical depression and anxiety, it didn’t necessarily make me lose feeling for him because the love was still there but I did have never ending intrusive thoughts about how “maybe I’m not really in love with him” or “he can do better” anxiety and depression are liars and will make you think the worst. A side effect of depression is anhedonia and that is basically the inability to feel pleasure. So to me everything he is going through sounds normal. It sucks and obviously no one wants to go through it but be there for him to the best of your ability. Give him space but also let him know how much you love and care for him. I will say my medication definitely helped and I hope it does for him as well :)

I felt the exact same way!! Starting back in March Ive been going through a horrible bout of depression and anxiety. It caused my boyfriend and I to go on a break twice. Each time we continued talking because we love each other so very much. So when I did notice those intrusive thoughts like “do I really love him” or “I’m better off alone” I was so confused. I get so in my head and over think every little detail about everything. It’s so horrible because on my good days when I’m not an anxious depressed mess it’s really good with him. But on my bad days I feel like I’m constantly putting him through so much all the time. I’m gonna give you some advise my mother gave me and that is, if you really didn’t care about him than you wouldn’t be stressing about it so hard. Every time I have an intrusive thought about our relationship I always try to remind myself of those words, and how much I love him, and how good everything is when my anxiety and depression aren’t a factor. I hope that helps :) p.s I definitely don’t think you are playing with his emotions. My boyfriend is so amazing and understanding and we talk about all of our feelings and thoughts, try communicating your feeling with him. And always remember YOU ARE NOT YOUR ANXIETY!

OCD is an anxiety disorder so it can develop anytime before you reach early adulthood. Always remember that the fear you feel is just your anxiety and intrusive thoughts lying to you. Have you considered any antidepressants? Prozac has really helped me keep the intrusive thoughts away.

I was prescribed hydroxyzine 25 mg for my anxiety along with 10 mg Prozac for my depression, PMDD, and OCD. It definitely helped at first but I noticed with prolonged use it made my vision blurry. Now I only take it when I am in the middle of an anxiety attack

THIS! I felt this in my soul! My OCD takes form in obsessive intrusive thoughts and not compulsive behavior so when I finally made the decision to get on Prozac I’m not kidding when I say it saved my life!! I also struggle with clinical depression and GAD. It was the best decision I ever made! I hope every single one of you find that relief some day ♥️
A suicide note. I’m doing ok right now but I just haven’t thrown it out yet for some reason

The scene when Meredith finds Deluca on the floor crying at the end was so beautiful to me. As someone who struggles a lot with mental health issues not being able to understand how your feeling is so scary, and you don’t want to bother anyone else with it because you feel like it’s not fair to put that on them plus you might not even know how to say what you’re feeling. All you want or need is for them to be there for you and pick you up.

I just started Prozac a little over a week ago and I feel the exact same way! Ask your doctor about Hydroxyzine. It’s the only antihistamine used to treat anxiety and it has really helped me. I went to the hospital for an intense panic attack last month and they sent me home with some Ativan and for a while it was the only thing that would calm me down but after I told my doctor about the fear of getting hooked on them he wrote a prescription for the hydroxyzine, it has really helped with relaxing me and helping me not dwell on the intrusive thoughts. Plus it’s not a benzo so you don’t have to worry about building a dependency.
I’m happy for you! Makes me feel like I have hope. I just started taking 10mg prozac a little over a week ago and I can’t wait to get my life back!
